mentions.name: Review Flow
mentions.description: An open-source Cursor / VSCode extension that makes the IDE a first-class environment for code reviews. It lets users navigate code and draft, modify, and submit comments on GitLab without switching to a browser, and auto-configures the Python environment using FastAPI for GitLab API calls. Suggestions, reviews, and contributions are invited.
mentions.problem: Frustration of needing to switch between the browser and the IDE to navigate through code and leave comments on Gitlab at work.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on this Review Flow. An extention for Cursor / VScode to enable IDE as first class for code reviews.
